In tvm_tirx::ir::expr

tvm_tirx::ir::expr

Struct PrimExpr 

Source 
pub struct PrimExpr { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

An expression typed by a PrimType (C++ PrimExpr): a constant, a variable, an operator on scalars or vectors, or a call that returns one.

PrimExpr and IntExpr are typed expressions: an Expr checked when the reference is made, so a function that takes one needs no check of its own. A typed expression converts into an Expr for free; an Expr converts into one only through TryFrom, whose error names the expression and its type.

§Examples

use tvm_tirx::ir::{dtype, Expr, PrimExpr, PrimType, PrimVar, StringImm, Var, UNKNOWN_LOC};

fn is_scalar(expr: &PrimExpr) -> bool {
    expr.prim_ty().is_scalar()
}

let x = PrimVar::new("x", PrimType::int(32), UNKNOWN_LOC);
assert!(is_scalar(&PrimExpr::try_from(&x + 1)?));

let text = Expr::from(StringImm::new("hi", UNKNOWN_LOC));
let error = PrimExpr::try_from(text).err().unwrap();
assert!(error.message().contains("ir.StringImm[ty=ir.StringType]"));

An Expr is not a PrimExpr until it is checked, nor a PrimExpr an IntExpr:

ⓘ
fn widen(expr: Expr) -> PrimExpr {
    expr
}
ⓘ
fn narrow(expr: PrimExpr) -> IntExpr {
    expr.into()
}

impl ObjectRefAnyCompatible for PrimExpr

Source§

fn extra_check(obj: &ExprObj) -> bool

Whether obj, an instance of ContainerType, is a value of Self. Every strict and converting cast checks it, after the object type.
Source§

fn convert_fallback(value: AnyView<'_>) -> Option<Self>

Convert a value that is not a Self object, such as an integer that stands for a constant; None rejects it. Only converting casts (TryFrom<Any>, typed function arguments) call it; downcast_ref, downcast and match_any! never do.
Source§

fn custom_type_str() -> String

The type name in conversion errors and type schemas; by default the object’s type key. See AnyCompatible::type_str.
Source§

fn custom_mismatch_type_info(value: AnyView<'_>) -> String

The name of the mismatched value in conversion errors; by default its runtime type key. See AnyCompatible::get_mismatch_type_info.
Source§
